generic_mechanism_candidate.authority_object: membership_epoch + finite ACTIVE role-incarnation set + wide_ticket_state + ticket_transition_id in one current CAS object
generic_mechanism_candidate.join: create/reconcile deterministic incarnation-sensitive role slot first; then CAS membership authority to ACTIVE only when no current REQUESTED ticket; rate-limit or response ambiguity fails closed until readback
generic_mechanism_candidate.leave: CAS membership authority to retiring/removed; stale old slot no longer counts toward current active bound
generic_mechanism_candidate.wide: CAS same membership authority to REQUESTED and capture exact ACTIVE role-incarnation set/epoch; membership mutations conflict with REQUESTED; new local operations read ticket then use only their own role-slot CAS
generic_mechanism_candidate.safety_claim: 0 modeled phantom/stale membership publication in the tested finite lattice
generic_mechanism_candidate.liveness_scope: finite model only; membership changes are blocked/conflicted during REQUESTED, so repeated membership churn does not create unbounded post-ticket phantoms in this model

negative_findings.fixed_membership_snapshot: unsafe because post-ticket JOIN/READD/RENAME/MIGRATE creates a phantom role not present in the captured slot set
negative_findings.append_only_registry_snapshot: still unsafe if membership can mutate after the scan; append-only history without a current epoch is not a predicate fence
negative_findings.separate_membership_epoch_recheck: safety survives by abort/retry, but repeated membership changes can starve wide publication unless a membership-churn bound or ticket block exists
negative_findings.stale_disabled_slot: without current membership authority, a stale slot can falsely remain in the finite set
negative_findings.response_loss: membership and slot creation need stable transition/incarnation IDs and current-state readback

clean_boundary_blocker.observation: The generic co-located membership/ticket authority is a cross-role semantic coordination object. Current multi_agent CLEAN config authorizes semantic reads only from own role-local clean state/public sources/own sanitized feedback/root/own config and writes only own role-local namespace plus own receipts. It forbids other-worker state and the shared aggregate execution ledger. No current role-authorized cross-role shared coordination manifest is exposed.
clean_boundary_blocker.consequence: Part44 cannot promote the generic shared membership/ticket object to a deployable current Phase-1 route. Using it would violate the repository CLEAN boundary even though the mechanism is safe in the finite model.
clean_boundary_blocker.non_solution: Do not treat an unavailable shared manifest or optimizer handoff as solved; it remains an unresolved child under control26.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_api_role: transport only; rate-limit interruption fails closed/checkpoints
